description: This source file defines the DefaultDittoLogger class, which provides an implementation of the DittoLogger interface. It manages SLF4J logging with support for correlation IDs and MDC entries, enabling structured and contextual logging within the Ditto services. The class encapsulates loggers, handles correlation ID propagation, MDC management, and offers various logging level methods.

classes.name: DefaultDittoLogger
classes.description: A thread-unsafe implementation of DittoLogger that manages SLF4J loggers with support for correlation IDs and MDC entries.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method that creates a DefaultDittoLogger instance using an SLF4J Logger.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the logger based on provided correlation ID or headers.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Explicitly sets the correlation ID for logging and tracking.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from the current logger.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the MDC for logging context.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a MDC key-value pair, returning a new logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries for structured logging.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the current logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace-level message, optionally with exceptions.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug-level message.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an info-level message.

methods.name: isWarnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warn level logging is enabled.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning-level message.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an error-level message.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current logger and resets it to the auto-closing logger.
